query:
SELECT s.id as sku_id, s.name, pfd.periodId, pfd.openingStock, pfd.adjustments, p.label, p.sortOrder 
FROM planning_fg_data pfd 
JOIN skus s ON s.id = pfd.skuId 
JOIN periods p ON p.id = pfd.periodId 
WHERE s.name LIKE '%Blueberry Mint%' AND s.weight = '50g'
ORDER BY p.sortOrder 
LIMIT 12
